evals.name: auto-drafts then confirms by options
evals.prompt: Set up my retention context. Site is bigdillpickleball.com.
expect: auto-drafts business model, lifecycle stages, and likely stack labeled [Inference]
confirms fields via quick options rather than open-ended questions

evals.name: does not silently assume the active definition
evals.prompt: We're a membership site, just give me the context file.
expect: flags the missing definition of 'active' as a required input
does not invent an active metric without confirmation
